items.html: And know that the plain “Yenika” that we mention in this composition of ours is the middle time between the first Ibur and the second Ibur mentioned, and it is the aspect of this last Yenika, in which ZA nurses from his mother's breasts, which are the breasts of a woman; for this is the true Yenika. For the first Yenika, which is in the secret of the breasts of an animal in the world of Beria, and likewise all the other degrees that follow it, as explained above, are all included in this one and are secondary to it. And this is the true Yenika that we mention in all this composition of ours. And remember — do not forget.
